environment: Vitest 4.1.11 / jsdom; simulated WebSocket, Web Audio, mediaDevices and Electron bridge; no real server or device

tests.name: keeps one connection when a subscribed view unmounts and remounts
closes the socket and stops scheduled audio when the broadcast is cleared
pairs binary audio and metadata in arrival order
does not play a metadata event that has no preceding audio
schedules successive PCM chunks on a continuous audio timeline
drops old-turn audio while an interruption awaits acknowledgement
does not schedule a pending decode after broadcast termination
reconnects an established connection after abnormal closure
exposes a failed handshake without an endless retry
exposes a permission-denied message and keeps recording inactive
distinguishes a missing microphone from permission denial
clears the broadcast and previous character dialogue after successful termination
treats an already missing broadcast (404) as locally terminated
retains the active session and exposes a server failure so termination can be retried
does not terminate the broadcast when its view unmounts
